description: Record a block of worked time on the calendar. Writes to the user's real schedule, so confirm the project, date and times with them before calling it. Requires the blocks:write scope; for an end-to-end-encrypted project a memo additionally needs PYUNTO_TM_PASSWORD so it can be encrypted locally.
